thesis: Public signals for Coca-Cola are mostly routine: filings are timely and insider activity is unremarkable. One high-severity item needs a response: a long-running tax dispute over intercompany pricing remains open in the courts.
invalidation_rationale: Signals are qualitative; a change in the flagged items would change the read.
conviction_reason: Signals point in different directions with no clear trend.
self_evidence_reason: Filing indexes were sampled; news-tone and hiring data were not available.
missing_data: Hiring and employee-sentiment data (no source in the inputs)

red_flags.flag: A long-running tax dispute over intercompany pricing remains open in the courts; an adverse outcome could require a sizeable cash payment.
Proposed sugar-tax measures are under discussion in several markets.

signals.signal: Recent current reports focus on routine business updates; volume pressure from changing consumer habits and currency translation is the recurring theme.
Quarterly filings arrived on the usual schedule with no late-filing notices.
Insider filings show routine award and plan-based transactions, no unusual clusters.
